notes: Literature check (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) only partly ran: the arXiv API returned HTTP 429 or timed out, so only 2 of the allowed queries completed (C1 broad query returned mostly off-topic traffic-signal-control work; one CARLA baseline query kept 1 result); no C2/C3 query, scout, coverage, similarity or novelty run, so per-claim novelty is from knowledge with [verify]. The script's 4-word query limit and the title/phrase refusal made claim queries for a GRPO-style method awkward. Ambiguities in the skill: (a) the five reviewers are specified as independent yet here share one context, which the skill allows but it is not truly independent; (b) the rule that a reviewer's Overall 4 needs pool position >= 65 conflicts mildly with giving a generalist an honest 4 for a paper most others place at 3; (c) summary 'after_composite' is ambiguous between official and EIC composite (used the EIC composite 54.2; the official composite stays 55.1); (d) shell restrictions (no redirection, variables or compound commands) make the literature scripts' large JSON outputs expensive to read since abstracts print in full; (e) the review text initially quoted before-run EIC numbers and had to be corrected after the AFTER run, because the skill orders the EIC write-up before the second script run.
